name: hubtiger_booking_availability_readonly
description: Check HubTiger workshop booking availability for a Ride Electric store and date. Read-only availability lookup. If unavailable, offer callback or staff follow-up.

request_body_schema.description:
Use when the caller wants workshop booking times. Read-only — does not create a booking.

Required: store (southport, brisbane, burleigh).

For "by [date]" requests (e.g. birthday 2 June): set payload.deadline_date or end_date to YYYY-MM-DD and payload.scheduling_goal to before_deadline. Omit start_date to search from today through that date.

Response: data.recommended_slot (best fit), data.backup_slots (two alternatives closest to the best), data.first_slots (same three for voice). Read message field to the caller.

If slot_count is 0, do not invent times — offer another store/date or callback.

Never expose raw JSON, trace IDs, or backend errors.

properties.description:
Description
Required. Ride Electric store slug. Use exactly one of: southport, brisbane, burleigh.
Optional. Search start date YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank when using payload.deadline_date (defaults to today).
Optional. End date in YYYY-MM-DD format if the caller gives a date range.
Optional cache mode. Use no_cache only when the caller says availability sounds stale or changed recently. Otherwise leave blank.
Optional. Use deadline_date (YYYY-MM-DD) when caller needs service BY a date (e.g. birthday 2 June). Use scheduling_goal before_deadline for that case. Include customer_request with their words.
Required for by-date requests. Last date the bike must be serviced by, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-02 for 2 June birthday).
Use before_deadline when they need service by deadline_date. Use earliest if they want the soonest slot.
Short summary of what the caller asked, e.g. serviced before my birthday on 2 June.
Optional notes about the service or issue, such as flat tyre, brake pads, general service, warranty check.
Optional preferred time if the caller gives one, such as morning, afternoon, or 10am.
